workbooks_new.author: Tessa Wyborn-Liang
workbooks_new.card_line: Make one small thing a week from what you already have at home.
outline: Week 1: clearing a small space and gathering materials you already own.
Week 2: a paper project, folding, cutting and sewing a small notebook.
Week 3: a thread project with three simple stitches.
Week 4: mending something you like.
Week 5: making a small gift.
Week 6: looking back at six small things and choosing what to make next.

title_check.note: Nearest: 'The 52 Week Project' and 'Weekend Handmade' (Kelly Wilkinson).

workbooks_new.title: The Walk With a Camera
workbooks_new.subtitle: Seeing Your Neighbourhood Through a Lens
workbooks_new.author: Tessa Wyborn-Liang
workbooks_new.card_line: Take a short walk each week with your phone or camera and look for one thing.
outline: Week 1: light, and walking at a different time of day.
Week 2: close up, with textures, plants and small details.
Week 3: people and places, and asking before you photograph someone.
Week 4: choosing ten photographs and making a small collection.

title_check.note: Nearest: 'Walking with Leica' and 'The Walk Book' (Janet Cardiff).

workbooks_new.editorial_note: Week 3 covers consent and privacy when photographing people, especially children.

excluded.author: Dorothea Brande (1893 to 1948)
excluded.title: Becoming a Writer (1934, Harcourt, Brace)
excluded.reason: UK clear (Brande died 1948, term ended end of 2018) but not US public domain. The US Copyright Office renewals list for July to December 1961 carries the cross-reference 'BRANDE, JUSTIN. Becoming a writer. SEE Collins, Dorothea Brande', so the copyright was renewed and runs 95 years, to the end of 2029.
